title: Coffee with a Friend

paragraphs.speaker: Sara
paragraphs.english: Hi Maryam! Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible this morning.
paragraphs.persian: سلام مریم! ببخشید دیر کردم. ترافیک امروز صبح وحشتناک بود.

paragraphs.speaker: Maryam
paragraphs.english: No problem! I only arrived five minutes ago. Do you want to order?
paragraphs.persian: مشکلی نیست! من هم پنج دقیقه پیش رسیدم. می‌خواهی سفارش بدهی؟

paragraphs.speaker: Sara
paragraphs.english: Yes, I'm really tired. I need a strong coffee. What about you?
paragraphs.persian: آره، خیلی خسته‌ام. یک قهوه قوی لازم دارم. تو چی؟

paragraphs.speaker: Maryam
paragraphs.english: Just a tea for me. I drank too much coffee yesterday and I couldn't sleep.
paragraphs.persian: برای من فقط چای. دیروز زیادی قهوه خوردم و نتوانستم بخوابم.

paragraphs.speaker: Sara
paragraphs.english: By the way, how was your job interview on Monday?
paragraphs.persian: راستی، مصاحبه کاری‌ات روز دوشنبه چطور بود؟

paragraphs.speaker: Maryam
paragraphs.english: It went well, I think. They will call me next week. I'm a little nervous about it.
paragraphs.persian: فکر می‌کنم خوب پیش رفت. هفته آینده با من تماس می‌گیرند. کمی نگرانم.

paragraphs.speaker: Sara
paragraphs.english: Don't worry. You have a lot of experience. I'm sure you will get it.
paragraphs.persian: نگران نباش. تو تجربه زیادی داری. مطمئنم قبول می‌شوی.

vocabulary.meaning: to ask for food or drink in a café
used to introduce a new topic

learningObjectives: Find specific information in a dialogue

exercises.prompt: What is this conversation mainly about?
options: Two friends meeting for a drink and talking about recent news
Two colleagues discussing a work project
exercises.explanation: They meet at a café, order drinks and catch up — the interview is one topic, not the whole point.

options: She was at a job interview
exercises.explanation: She says: 'The traffic was terrible this morning.'

exercises.prompt: Why does Maryam order tea instead of coffee?
options: Too much coffee yesterday stopped her sleeping
exercises.explanation: 'I drank too much coffee yesterday and I couldn't sleep.'

exercises.prompt: In this dialogue, 'nervous' is closest in meaning to:
exercises.explanation: Nervous = worried about something that may happen.

exercises.prompt: What will probably happen next week?
options: Maryam will start a new job immediately
The company will contact Maryam about the interview result
Sara will have a job interview
They will meet at the same café
exercises.explanation: 'They will call me next week' — the result is coming, not the job itself yet.
